events.title: Feedback Appreciation
events.summary: Hello everyone, dear friends! This is Qingtong. Thank you so much for participating in our second playtest! 🎮 This playtest will conclude on March 15th. We have collected all the player feedback and are currently making adjustments accordingly. More exciting content will be featured in the next demo version – stay tuned!
